# Test pe pipeline commands - Unix-style composability

# Basic pipeline
echo "What is the capital of France?" | pe ask | pe filter --pattern "Paris"
stdout 'Paris'

# Multi-stage pipeline
pe run "List 5 random numbers" | pe stream | pe analyze --type statistical
stdout 'Mean:'
stdout 'Median:'
stdout 'Std Dev:'

# Pipeline with file processing
cat data.jsonl | pe ask --template "Summarize: {{.}}" | pe filter --json .summary
stdout '"Quick summary'
stdout '"Brief overview'

# Streaming pipeline
pe run "Count from 1 to 10" --stream | pe filter --match "^[5-9]"
stdout '5'
stdout '6'
stdout '7'
stdout '8'
stdout '9'
! stdout '10'

# Analysis pipeline
pe run "Generate a paragraph about AI" | pe analyze --metrics readability,sentiment
stdout 'Readability score:'
stdout 'Flesch-Kincaid:'
stdout 'Sentiment: positive'

# Transform pipeline
echo "HELLO WORLD" | pe ask "Convert to lowercase" | pe filter --transform lowercase
stdout 'hello world'

# Parallel pipeline processing
pe run "Task 1" --async &
pe run "Task 2" --async &
pe run "Task 3" --async &
wait
pe collect --jobs 3
stdout 'Collected 3 results'

# Pipeline with error handling
! echo "Invalid JSON" | pe filter --json .field
stderr 'JSON parse error'

# Complex pipeline with multiple stages
pe run prompt.txt |
  pe optimize --method textgrad --quiet |
  pe test --inline test-cases.yaml |
  pe analyze --format json
stdout '"optimization_score"'
stdout '"test_results"'
stdout '"analysis"'

# Pipeline with caching
pe run "Expensive computation" --cache | pe filter --field result
stdout 'Result: 42'
# Second run should use cache
pe run "Expensive computation" --cache | pe filter --field result
stdout 'Result: 42'
stdout '(cached)'

# Aggregation pipeline
seq 1 5 | pe ask --template "Double {{.}}" --parallel | pe reduce --sum
stdout '30'  # 2+4+6+8+10

# Pipeline with conditions
pe run "Check status" | pe filter --if-contains "OK" --then "pe run success.txt" --else "pe run failure.txt"
stdout 'Operation successful'

-- data.jsonl --
{"text": "First item needing summary"}
{"text": "Second item for processing"}
{"text": "Third data point"}

-- prompt.txt --
Explain quantum computing in simple terms.

-- test-cases.yaml --
tests:
  - input: "What is quantum?"
    assert: 
      - contains: "quantum"
  - input: "How does it work?"
    assert:
      - contains: "qubit"

-- success.txt --
Operation successful

-- failure.txt --
Operation failed
